title: The sync range leak gate refuses internal-root content that the tracked-file scan accepts, so a team clone cannot sync its own internal facts
goal: kbpublic.range_leaks reads the files of an internal root and of a pointer for secrets only, as tree_hits does, so a team clone's sync leak gate passes the internal-root facts the tracked-file scan passes; a secret in a file of an internal root or of a pointer is still refused by the sync leak gate, as is any hit in a file outside them; kbpublic.SCAN_FORM is above 6, so no range verdict cached under the old rule is read
